title: Giant Four
hook: Giant four in a row on the town square: walk to a column, press E, your disc slides in. Four in a row wins.
prompt: giant four in a row with friends

controls.interact: drop your disc in the column you stand in (on your turn)

round.winBy: first to line up four discs

world.notes: A seven by six board lies flat on the paving in the middle of the square.

mechanics.as: a giant four in a row on the floor

rules.summary: Players take turns. On your turn walk to a column of the floor board and press E: your disc slides to the far free cell. Four discs of one colour in a row, column or diagonal win. A full board is a draw. Alone, bots take the other seats.

accept: turn order is the same on every screen
a move out of turn is refused
